meta.name: cursor-hook-compat-fixtured
meta.description: Fixture memory for Mneme-Cursor hook compatibility validation. Uses typed FORBID_LITERAL rules (always enforced, retrieval-independent per ADR-017/ADR-019), not multi-term anti_patterns (which are retrieval-gated).

decisions.decision: Do not allow 'install legacy-client' in any architectural context.
decisions.rationale: Global typed literal enforcement. Used by T1-T3, T5-T10.

decisions.decision: Do not allow 'install cursor-only-client' inside .cursor or similar tooling directories.
decisions.rationale: Scoped typed literal enforcement for T4 (irrelevant-path testing). Governs only .cursor/ artifacts.
